 Republican US Senate Candidate to Stop in Jefferson Tomorrow 
 Posted By: Coltrane Carlson 
 October 23, 2026 @ 5:18 am
 Today's Local News 
 Tweet 
 Share 
 Email 
 Image courtesy of Ashley Hinson campaign
 The Republican candidate for US Senate will be making a campaign stop in Jefferson tomorrow. 
 According to the Ashley Hinson for Senate Campaign, the US Congresswoman will be at the Jefferson Community Golf Course Clubhouse tomorrow at 10:30am for the “Ashley for Iowa: Jefferson Rally.” Organizers say the visit to Greene County is part of Hinson’s “Fighting for Iowa Tour” as she will be rallying people to vote. 
 Anyone wanting to attend must RSVP by clicking here . 
 Representative Hinson is running for US Senate against Democrat Josh Turek and Libertarian Thomas Laehn.
